result:
All tests pass (47/47) in `MethodUtilsAgentTest`, covering `getAccessibleMethod`, `getMethodObject`, `getMatchingAccessibleMethod`, `getMatchingMethod` (including same-class ambiguous-overload detection), `getAnnotation` (direct, inherited via `searchSupers`, and NPE cases), `getMethodsListWithAnnotation`/`getMethodsWithAnnotation`, `getOverrideHierarchy` (with/without interfaces), and the `invokeMethod`/`invokeExactMethod`/`invokeStaticMethod`/`invokeExactStaticMethod` family (varargs, private methods with `forceAccess`, exact-vs-widening matching, `NoSuchMethodException`, `NullPointerException`, and propagated `InvocationTargetException`).

No failing tests remain — I found no bugs in `MethodUtils` itself. (One test initially failed because I'd misjudged the ambiguity rule in `getMatchingMethod`: it only throws `IllegalStateException` when the equally-good candidates come from the *same* declaring class, not merely the same distance across different classes in the hierarchy — that's correct, intentional behavior, so I fixed the test fixture rather than flagging it as a bug.)
